claimBoundary.const: Adaptive post-hoc development reflection over already-inspected BioReason-Pro cases; not held-out evaluation, promotion, or evidence of generalization.

enum: Only 10 adaptively inspected proteins are available; this is too small for accuracy optimization or a new promotion claim.
At least one GO namespace has candidate-recall ceiling below 0.50; threshold mutation cannot recover missing GO terms.
No candidate donor support has an applied lineage factor; phylogeny-aware reweighting is inactive on this cohort.

prefixItems.const: A benchmark integrity review that verifies sequence/accession/function/GO consistency before optimization.
A larger homology-clustered development set plus fresh, mutually exclusive sealed promotion shards.
Pinned GO ontology, annotation release, taxon constraints, and anonymous-query phylogeny inference with uncertainty.
Candidate-generation evidence beyond Swiss-Prot similarity transfer (for example InterPro/GO mapping or a frozen protein-language-model predictor).
